terms.gloss: a Roman high priest, a pontiff; their head was the pontifex maximus

phrases.latin: prīmī diēs mēnsium nōminātī Kalendae, quod hīs diēbus calantur ejus mēnsis Nōnae ā pontificibus
phrases.english: the first days of the months were named the Kalends, because on those days the Nones of that month are called out by the pontiffs
